metadata.description: The vibe plugin: the skills, agents and guard that take a project from idea to delivered software, in any repository, with the Groundwork governance layer laid over a project only when its owner asks for it.

plugins.name: vibe
plugins.description: Fourteen skills (start, begin, scope, spec, stack, architect, design, verify, code-review, debug, deliver, maintain, handoff, comply), three review agents on Sonnet, and the guard that refuses a bypassed gate or a force-push before it runs.
